# Tool catalog

<!-- GENERATED by ha-mcp/scripts/gen-tools-doc.mjs — do not edit by hand. Run `npm run docs:tools` in ha-mcp/. -->

94 tools. Each group appears only when its add-on switch is on. `*` = required parameter.
Kinds come from the MCP annotations: *read-only* never changes anything; *write* changes state;
**destructive** can remove data or disrupt the system (Claude is told to confirm first; the riskiest also need `confirm: true`).

## Always on (read-only) (12)

Switch: none

| Tool | Kind | Parameters | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `ha_get_calendar_events` | read-only | `entity_id`*, `start`, `end` | Get events from a calendar entity between two times. |
| `ha_get_config` | read-only | — | Get basic info about the Home Assistant instance: version, location name, time zone, unit system, and whether it is running. |
| `ha_get_error_log` | read-only | `level`, `search`, `limit`, `include_exceptions` | Get recent errors and warnings logged by Home Assistant (the same list as Settings → System → Logs), newest first. |
| `ha_get_history` | read-only | `entity_ids`*, `start_time`, `end_time`, `hours`, `max_points` | Get state history for one or more entities over a time range. |
| `ha_get_logbook` | read-only | `entity_id`, `start_time`, `end_time`, `hours`, `limit` | Get logbook entries (what happened and why: automations triggered, lights turned on, doors opened). |
| `ha_get_state` | read-only | `entity_ids`* | Get the full current state and all attributes of one or more entities, e.g. ['climate.living_room', 'sensor.outdoor_temperature']. |
| `ha_list_areas` | read-only | `include_entities` | List all areas (rooms) with their id, name, and the entities assigned to each. |
| `ha_list_calendars` | read-only | — | List calendar entities in Home Assistant. |
| `ha_list_domains` | read-only | — | List entity domains (light, sensor, switch, climate, automation, ...) with how many entities each has. |
| `ha_list_entities` | read-only | `domain`, `area`, `search`, `state`, `limit` | List entities with their current state, in a compact form. |
| `ha_list_services` | read-only | `domain` | List the actions (services) Home Assistant offers. |
| `ha_render_template` | read-only | `template`*, `timeout_seconds` | Render a Home Assistant Jinja template and return the result. |

## Actions (18)

Switch: `enable_actions`

| Tool | Kind | Parameters | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `ha_activate_scene` | write | `entity_ids`*, `transition` | Activate one or more scenes (scene.*), optionally fading lights over 'transition' seconds. |
| `ha_call_service` | **destructive** | `domain`*, `service`*, `target`, `data`, `return_response` | Call any Home Assistant action (a.k.a. |
| `ha_control_cover` | write | `entity_ids`, `area_id`, `floor_id`, `device_id`, `label_id`, `action`*, `position`, `tilt_position` | Open, close, stop or position covers (blinds, shades, curtains, shutters, awnings, garage doors, gates) and valves. |
| `ha_control_media_player` | write | `entity_ids`*, `action`*, `volume_level`, `source`, `sound_mode`, `media_content_id`, `media_content_type`, `enqueue`, `announce`, `shuffle`, `repeat`, `seek_position` | Control media players (speakers, TVs, receivers, Chromecast, Sonos, etc.). |
| `ha_conversation` | **destructive** | `text`*, `language`, `agent_id`, `conversation_id` | Send a natural-language command or question to Home Assistant's Assist (conversation agent), exactly like typing into the Assist dialog, and get its spoken reply. |
| `ha_fire_event` | **destructive** | `event_type`*, `event_data` | Fire a custom event on the Home Assistant event bus, e.g. to trigger automations that listen for it. |
| `ha_manage_todo` | write | `entity_id`*, `action`*, `item`, `rename`, `status`, `due_date`, `due_datetime`, `description`, `status_filter` | Read and edit to-do lists (todo.*, e.g. the shopping list). |
| `ha_press_button` | write | `entity_ids`* | Press button entities (button.* from devices, e.g. restart, identify, start-a-program) or input_button helpers. |
| `ha_run_script` | write | `entity_id`*, `variables`, `wait_for_response` | Run a Home Assistant script, optionally with variables (the script's fields). |
| `ha_send_notification` | write | `message`*, `title`, `service`, `entity_id`, `persistent`, `target`, `data` | Send a notification. |
| `ha_set_automation_enabled` | write | `entity_ids`*, `enabled`*, `stop_actions` | Enable (enabled:true) or disable (enabled:false) automations so they do or don't react to their triggers. |
| `ha_set_climate` | write | `entity_ids`*, `hvac_mode`, `temperature`, `target_temp_low`, `target_temp_high`, `fan_mode`, `preset_mode`, `swing_mode`, `humidity` | Control climate entities (thermostats, AC, heat pumps): HVAC mode, target temperature or range, fan mode, preset, swing, humidity. |
| `ha_set_value` | write | `entity_id`*, `value`* | Set the value of a value-holding entity; the right action is picked from its domain: input_number / number / counter → set_value (number, range-checked); input_text / text → set_value; input_select / select → select_o… |
| `ha_toggle` | write | `entity_ids`, `area_id`, `floor_id`, `device_id`, `label_id`, `domain`, `transition`, `data` | Toggle one or more entities of any switchable type: light, switch, fan, input_boolean, media_player, climate, humidifier, water_heater, siren, remote, automation, script, group, cover (toggles), valve. |
| `ha_trigger_automation` | write | `entity_ids`*, `skip_condition` | Run an automation's actions now, as if it had been triggered. |
| `ha_turn_off` | write | `entity_ids`, `area_id`, `floor_id`, `device_id`, `label_id`, `domain`, `transition`, `data` | Turn off one or more entities of any switchable type: light, switch, fan, input_boolean, media_player, climate, humidifier, water_heater, siren, remote, automation, script, group, cover (closes), valve. |
| `ha_turn_on` | write | `entity_ids`, `area_id`, `floor_id`, `device_id`, `label_id`, `domain`, `brightness_pct`, `color_name`, `rgb_color`, `color_temp_kelvin`, `percentage`, `transition`, `data` | Turn on one or more entities of any switchable type: light, switch, fan, input_boolean, media_player, climate, humidifier, water_heater, siren, remote, automation, script, group, cover (opens), valve. |
| `ha_vacuum` | write | `entity_ids`*, `action`*, `fan_speed` | Control robot vacuums (vacuum.*): start, pause, stop, return_to_base, locate, clean_spot, set_fan_speed (fan_speed from its fan_speed_list). |

## Config files (12)

Switch: `enable_config_files`

| Tool | Kind | Parameters | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `ha_check_config` | read-only | — | Ask Home Assistant to validate the whole YAML configuration on disk (like Developer tools > Check configuration). |
| `ha_delete_config_file` | **destructive** | `path`* | Remove a file from the Home Assistant config directory. |
| `ha_delete_secret` | **destructive** | `name`*, `file` | Remove a name from secrets.yaml (the previous file is backed up). |
| `ha_edit_config_file` | **destructive** | `path`*, `replacements`, `yaml_operations`, `expected_sha256`, `force`, `dry_run` | Make targeted changes to an existing file in the Home Assistant config directory, keeping comments and formatting. |
| `ha_list_config_backups` | read-only | `path`* | List the saved previous versions of a config file (newest first; the last 20 are kept). |
| `ha_list_config_files` | read-only | `path`, `pattern`, `max_depth`, `include_all_text`, `include_system`, `limit` | List YAML files in the Home Assistant config directory (recursively), with size and modification time. |
| `ha_list_secrets` | read-only | — | List the NAMES defined in secrets.yaml files (values are never shown), plus !secret references in YAML files that are not defined anywhere, and names that are defined but not referenced. |
| `ha_read_config_file` | read-only | `path`*, `start_line`, `end_line` | Read a text file from the Home Assistant config directory (e.g. 'configuration.yaml', 'packages/lights.yaml'). |
| `ha_reload_config` | write | `target`*, `check_first` | Apply changed YAML without restarting Home Assistant by reloading one part: automation, script, scene, group, template, input_* helpers, timer, counter, schedule, zone, person, core (homeassistant: section incl. |
| `ha_restore_config_backup` | **destructive** | `path`*, `backup_id` | Put a saved version of a config file back (undo a write, edit or delete). |
| `ha_set_secret` | **destructive** | `name`*, `secret_value`*, `file` | Add or change a value in secrets.yaml, to be used in YAML as '!secret <name>'. |
| `ha_write_config_file` | **destructive** | `path`*, `content`*, `create_only`, `expected_sha256`, `force`, `dry_run` | Create a new file or replace a file's whole content in the Home Assistant config directory. |
